sanskrit_verse:
तस्मादन्नात् पुनर्यज्ञः पुनरन्नं पुनः क्रतुः ।
एवमेतदनाद्यन्तं चक्रं संपरिवर्तते ॥१२४॥
transliteration: tasmād annāt punar yajñaḥ punar annaṃ punaḥ kratuḥ / evam etad anādyantaṃ cakraṃ saṃparivartate // YajñS_3.124
sph_interpretive_translation: From food arises sacrifice; from sacrifice arises food; again ritual action produces both. Thus revolves this endless cycle without beginning or end.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the sustaining source of existence itself
Causation is cyclical and interdependent, not linearly punitive
Capacity-based responsibility emerges through participation in the sustaining order
Restoration logic aligns with natural reciprocity rather than retributive causality
Consciousness alignment occurs when one recognizes oneself as part of the eternal cycle
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual consumes societal resources THEN they are inherently obligated to contribute reciprocally via dharmic action.
IF a person performs ritual or civic duty THEN their right to sustenance is automatically reaffirmed by cosmic-social contract.
WHEN disruption occurs in social equilibrium THEN restoration must follow the principle of anādi-ananta flow: no start, no finish, only balance.
IF consciousness acknowledges its role within the cycle THEN punitive measures become irrelevant due to self-alignment with dharma.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating economic or civic disputes, the Supreme Court shall recognize that all citizens exist within an unbroken cycle of mutual obligation rooted in consumption and contribution. Legal decisions must enforce reciprocal accountability while rejecting punitive frameworks that sever individuals from societal integration.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa-based causality through observable reciprocity: food enables worship, worship generates abundance, and ritual maintains order. Responsibility follows capacity to participate, not fault. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) reflects continuous engagement, not episodic transgression. Therefore, justice aligns with sustaining flow, not punitive correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure disrupted cycles are completed through reciprocal acts of service or offering.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Facilitate conscious recognition of one's place within the sustaining loop.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Realign individual ability to participate through education, resource access, or spiritual initiation.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Guide violators back into harmonious participation without shame or exclusion.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagvan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source of Law. Dharma is restored through recognition of the eternal, non-linear cycle of mutual sustenance. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
